rows.text: when bit 0 of byte `+0x3A` of `rcx` is set, sets byte `+0x3B` to 1 and clears that bit (AND `0xFE`); otherwise returns without work

returns 0 when `rcx` is null, when its qword `+0xC0` is null or when the dword that pointer addresses is -1; otherwise returns 1, first making the call at `002E4F40` + 0x4E with `rcx` = qword `022C6F28` plus the pointer's signed word `+0` times 0x740 unless that word is `0xFFFF`, the sum is zero or dword `+0x284` of that element is 0

returns 0.0 when `rcx` is null, when its qword `+0xC0` is null or when the dword that pointer addresses is -1; returns 30.0 (`008F8D80`) when that pointer's word `+0` is `0xFFFF`, when qword `022C6F28` plus the signed word times 0x740 is zero, or when dword `+0x284` of that element is 0; otherwise tail-jumps through the site `002E9560` + 0x45 with `rcx` = the element

returns 0 when `rcx` is null, when its signed word `+0x1E` is negative, when dword `+0x5C` of the 0x120-byte entry at `02161DA0` + that word times 0x120 differs from dword `+0x24` of `rcx`, or when `edx` is negative; otherwise returns 1 when bit `edx` (modulo 32) of the entry's dword `+0x40` is set, else 0

notes: 002E4F40: the block at 002E4F5C (null rcx) reaches the 0 return through a test of a zeroed rax, so a null rcx returns 0.
